title: pytest verification
description: Fixtures and test cases for Python projects that use pytest.

rules.instruction: Use fixtures with the smallest scope that fits the resource. Give each test independent mutable state and arrange cleanup for resources it creates.
rules.verification: Run a changed test alone and with its suite. Confirm that failing test setup or execution leaves disposable resources ready for the next run.

rules.instruction: Parameterize cases that exercise the same behavior across inputs. Give the cases names that reveal the boundary or failure reason.
rules.verification: Confirm that the cases show up separately in test collection and check their expected outcomes against the behavior contract.

rules.instruction: Use the same public entry points as callers when writing regression tests. Keep narrow unit tests for behavior that can be exercised without external services.
rules.verification: Run the regression on the affected Python version and confirm the observed result at the public interface.
